summary: Iter84 — full-stack verification of the read-only coach memory + /trends transparency features. BACKEND (9/9 tests in test_iter84_coach_memory.py): 401 for GET /api/coach/memory & GET /api/analytics & POST correction & DELETE memory when unauth; POST /api/coach/memory/correction with empty string → 400; happy-path correction (analytics_injury) folded 'knee is fine now / physio' into the summary, persisted via GET, and the follow-up POST /api/coach/chat surfaced the corrected fact; DELETE returns {deleted:true}, subsequent GET returns {summary:null, updatedAt:null}, and coach chat still returns 200 with a valid response after memory is cleared. FRONTEND: /trends renders correctly for all 4 non-empty scenarios — analytics_creep shows FATIGUE (Normal) with explanation, RPE CREEP for Bench Press 'RPE 7 → 7.5 → 8.5 → 9 at ~185 lbs', STRENGTH, WEEKLY VOLUME stacked bars, COMPLIANCE, and 'updated 33m ago' label; analytics_e1rm STRENGTH card shows 'Entered 1RM 300 lbs · effective 324 lbs (+8%)' plus the 'Your coach may suggest updating this.' note; analytics_thin shows the [data-testid=trends-low-confidence] 'Limited data — under 3 weeks of logs' banner; analytics_empty currently has stray logs from prior seed runs so it shows the low-confidence path (banner + real minimal cards, NO fabricated/zero-filled cards — behaves per the request note). Programs tab → open-trends row (testID=open-trends) navigates to /trends. SETTINGS memory card: test_strongman shows [data-testid=coach-memory-empty] with 'Your coach is still getting to know you'; analytics_creep shows summary text with Correct/Clear buttons. Full correction UX works end-to-end via the UI — typed 'I'm now training for a strongman meet in October 2026.', tapped Send correction, saw 'Your coach will remember that.' confirm within 4s, and the summary text updated to lead with 'Training for a strongman meet in October 2026.' (the correction was placed FIRST — override behavior confirmed). Clear memory then reset the card back to the empty state (verified visually in screenshot). Settings regression: INJURIES / POCKET COACH / NOTIFICATIONS / WHAT YOUR COACH KNOWS ABOUT YOU all render. Deprecated package detected (pre-existing, from iter83): expo-av — should be migrated to expo-audio / expo-video per SDK 54 deprecation warning in console.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated in SDK 54 — console emits '[expo-av]: Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Use the `expo-audio` and `expo-video` packages'. Pre-existing (not caused by this iteration); should be migrated. Reference: package.json dependency.

action_items: Nothing blocking. All scenarios in the review request pass end-to-end (both backend endpoints and the two Settings/trends UIs).

Nice-to-have: analytics_empty user now has stray logs so its /trends renders the low-confidence path instead of the pristine empty state (request already anticipated this). If you need a true empty-state visual on trends, re-seed with a fresh user that has ZERO logs, or add a script that wipes db.logs for analytics_empty before manual verification.

Nice-to-have: /trends cards themselves have no testIDs (only trends-back / trends-empty-state / trends-low-confidence). Consider adding testID='trends-fatigue-card' / 'trends-strength-card' / 'trends-rpe-creep-card' etc. so future test scripts can assert individual card visibility without falling back to innerText scraping.
Migrate expo-av → expo-audio / expo-video (pre-existing deprecation warning, carried over from iter83 report).
critical_code_review_comments: Correction override behavior is real end-to-end: the returned summary AND the persisted summary now lead with the new fact ('Training for a strongman meet in October 2026'), and the older fatigue/deload content is retained but demoted to secondary. The Claude system prompt correctly treats the correction as authoritative.
Auth is enforced on every new endpoint (GET/POST/DELETE /api/coach/memory) — the middleware-level 401 is consistent with GET /api/analytics.

Settings memory card handles both states correctly: empty state uses [testID=coach-memory-empty]; with-memory state uses [testID=coach-memory-summary] + correct/clear affordances with proper disabled states while saving.

Clear-memory flow is guarded by an Alert.alert confirm dialog with a 'destructive' Cancel/Clear pair. Note: on React Native Web, Alert.alert's confirm dialog did not surface a Playwright-catchable `dialog` event (the modal is rendered inline via RN Web's Alert polyfill), yet the destructive path still ran and memory was cleared — this is a testing observation, not a bug, but future test scripts should NOT rely on page.on('dialog', …) to auto-accept and should instead locate the modal's 'Clear memory' button and click it directly for deterministic UI-level teardown.

Feature-flag-style rendering on /trends is doing the right thing: for the 'thin' user only WEEKLY VOLUME shows the current week's bar and past weeks are blank — no fake baseline. RPE CREEP card is only rendered when the analytics engine actually flags it (confirmed present for creep user, absent for e1rm).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested flows verified visually + via testID queries)

seed_data_creation: None. Existing seeded analytics users (creep/e1rm/injury/thin/empty) were reused. The correction test on analytics_creep DID update its db.coach_memory doc (added the strongman-meet fact and then cleared it via the UI Clear flow at the end of the run). analytics_injury's memory was overwritten with the 'left knee is fine / physio' correction and then cleared by the backend test — so both users end iter84 with EMPTY memory docs, matching a clean baseline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New reusable file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter84_coach_memory.py — pytest classes TestUnauth, TestCorrectionFlow, TestClearMemory. Run with: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=... pytest test_iter84_coach_memory.py -v. It uses analytics_injury@test.com (correction ends up folded then cleared) — safe to re-run idempotently. Frontend web login workaround still required: navigate to root, POST /api/auth/login via page.evaluate, localStorage.setItem('auth_token', token), then navigate to target route. On React Native Web, Alert.alert for multi-button destructive dialogs does NOT emit page.on('dialog') — the modal is inline in the DOM. If you need to programmatically confirm a Clear/Delete alert, query for the modal button by text 'Clear memory' / 'Delete' and click it directly. Empty-state visual on /trends can only be re-verified for a user with zero logs — analytics_empty has drifted from that. For a pristine empty-state check, create a fresh account or clear db.logs first.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. All backend endpoints behave per spec (auth, override, delete, chat-after-clear resilience) and every UI testID mentioned in the review request is present and functional. The one deviation flagged (analytics_empty showing low-confidence instead of empty state) is a seed-data drift issue that the review request itself pre-warned about.
